one_line: Work management platform for teams to plan and track projects and tasks.
auth_notes: REST API; PAT or service-account tokens for org-internal testing, OAuth for distributed apps; app registration in the developer console; apps private by default.
self_serve_notes: Free Basic tier exists, then paid Starter/Advanced; PATs are self-service in the developer console; paid-feature testing needs a requested developer sandbox.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Tasks, projects, sections, portfolios, goals, users, workspaces, stories, attachments, webhooks, time tracking.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for reacting to task/project changes.

existing_mcp.note: Community Asana MCP servers exist; official Asana MCP not confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched 'Build an app with Asana' page confirms REST API, PAT vs OAuth, webhooks, and developer console flow.

agent_notes: Embedded API explorer and free account make first call fast; advanced features gated to paid tiers.
